candidates.change_summary: Replace the require that prevents re-locking (guesses[msg.sender].block == 0) with its negation, allowing lockInGuess to only be called when a guess already exists, changing post-call stored guess state for callers with prior guesses.
Remove the require(msg.value == 1 ether) check so callers can call lockInGuess with any value, changing whether state is updated after the call when msg.value differs.
Set guesses[msg.sender].block to current block.number instead of block.number + 1, altering the stored block value visible after the call.
Store the provided hash into a different field (overwrite only the block field with the hash cast), causing the visible guesses[msg.sender].block to differ after the call.
Insert an assignment that clears the guess immediately after setting it, so after the call the stored guess differs (is zeroed) while block is still set.

Move the assignment to guesses[msg.sender].block to occur before setting guesses[msg.sender].guess, changing intermediate observable state and final stored values if reentrancy or checks inspect order.
Change the comparison that checks block progression from '>' to '>=' so settle can run when block.number equals the stored block number.
Zero out the stored block AFTER checking the guess and possible transfer, so settle retains the original stored block during comparison and transfer decision.
Remove the balance check before transfer so transfer is attempted regardless of contract balance, changing behavior when funds are insufficient.
